summary: RFC-0062 OQ-2: RFC-0014 composition settled on max; live dispatch rank is wave, effective-priority bucket, critical-path cost, age bonus, id

options.description: Amend RFC-0014 s5.2 to max; rank by effective-priority bucket, then critical-path cost, then age bonus, then id
Critical-path cost first, effective priority as tie-break
max; bucket then id, no critical-path term in Phase 1

body: Full rubric in RFC-0062 OQ-2 resolution (2026-11-06). RFC-0014 says + in s5.2 and max in s5.3 and Q1; the code uses max; the live path uses neither. Priority inheritance in real-time systems is always max (sum inflates with graph size). Critical-path-first ordering optimises makespan but lets a long chain of mediums outrank a single critical fix.
